name: daily-aeo-report
description: Generate and deliver daily AEO analytics report to Telegram (via claudeclaw MAESTER task astgl-daily-report)

preExec.description: Build AEO report from query logs, knowledge base stats, and discovery pipeline. Runs dist (not tsx) and omits --discord: the Discord LaunchAgent was retired 2026-07-26; MAESTER parses this JSON and delivers to Telegram.

instructions: If query volume increased significantly, note the trend.
If low-confidence queries appear, these are content gaps — flag for new article ideas.
If stale content is flagged, consider refreshing those articles.
If discovery pipeline has pending items, the structuring pipeline may need attention.
